> A carrier board for the Tuya T5AI-Core. The T5 is already a complete voice dev board, so I'm not redesigning it — I'm building the layer it plugs into. All 44 pins seat into a socket on this board, which breaks them out into three tactile buttons (mode, up, down), a connector for an ILI9341 display, and a header for a chime circuit. What makes it mine: this is week one of five. This board, a 3D-printed wedge enclosure, a 555 chime, a screen and a discrete-logic timer are all becoming one desk study companion — and I already wrote the voice firmware for it last month. This is the piece that turns that code into an actual object on my desk.
